name: General Mills - Cedar Rapids IA (Edgewood Rd)

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed General Mills cereal manufacturing complex at 4800 Edgewood Rd SW, Cedar Rapids IA. Geocode pin landed accurately on the process building; locked center 41.9322,-91.7202. This is the ONLY General Mills facility in Cedar Rapids (confirmed via Cedar Rapids Metro Economic Alliance directory).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully enclosed by black ornamental metal perimeter fence (clearly visible in 2019/2024 Street View along the access road off Edgewood Rd SW). A single private access road serves the campus; GM directional signage reads 'Frontage Road' and 'South Entrance'. Treated as a controlled truck entrance though Street View coverage stops at the property line.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identifiable from Street View - the public road panos do not extend onto the private entry drive, so a booth could exist beyond the fence but none seen. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on assumption of a gate without a confirmed staffed booth; low confidence - flagged.
fieldNotes.railServed: Extensive multi-track rail yard runs along the entire south edge of the property with many covered hopper cars (grain/cereal ingredient). Rail spurs penetrate into rail-served loading canopies on the SE side. Definitively rail-served.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: SW distribution warehouse has a continuous dock bank on its SE face (~20+ trailers backed in). Additional dock banks on the central process complex and rail-served loading area. Estimated 50+ total.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large organized trailer drop yard at the NW corner (~120-150 trailers in marked rows) plus additional staged trailers near the SW warehouse and process complex. Well over 50.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus comprises the central process/manufacturing complex, a large SW distribution warehouse, two NW warehouse buildings, and rail-served structures - multiple distinct building clusters.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity is spread across physically separate building faces - the SW warehouse dock bank and the central/rail-served docks - supporting separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved access road and large aprons inside the property line provide room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified in imagery; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box ~224 acres including the rail yard and some undeveloped/retention land; the paved industrial core is roughly 90-110 acres.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial setting on the SW fringe of Cedar Rapids surrounded by farmland and a quarry; classified Rural per the small-town-vs-Urban tiebreak rule.
